name: library-api-postman
description: Postman collection for the Library API, run headless with Newman

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:data
scripts.test:api: newman run library-api.postman_collection.json -e env/${POSTMAN_ENV:-local}.postman_environment.json --folder '00 Smoke' --folder '01 Books CRUD' --folder '02 Negative' -r cli,allure --reporter-allure-resultsDir allure-results
scripts.test:data: newman run library-api.postman_collection.json -e env/${POSTMAN_ENV:-local}.postman_environment.json --folder '03 Data-driven' -d data/books.csv -r cli,allure --reporter-allure-resultsDir allure-results
